text: Did you know if you dump 2 pints of tomatoes into a pot,then add one quartered shallot,3 cloves of garlic, some salt,olive oil, more olive oil. Give it a mixand add 1 block of feta. Drizzle some olive oil,sprinkle some thyme and bake for 40 minutes.Take it out of the oven, add some cooked pasta,stir it up.A little bit of limeworked.Then you've just made an insanely delicious one pot pasta
